purpose: Reapplicable companion provider source patches for gows-ab-v1; no binaries, sessions or dependency source archives.

patch_validation.method: Private GIT_INDEX_FILE; read-tree exact upstream base; git apply --check --cached --whitespace=error-all; git apply --cached; git write-tree compared with the committed provider source.
patch_validation.local_commit_note: Checkpoint commits identify provenance, not commits published upstream. Applying patches reproduces trees, not commit identity.

licenses.scope: Both provider LICENSE files are byte-identical Apache-2.0. WAHA package metadata remains UNLICENSED. Dependency, dashboard and compiled image licensing are separate; see README.md.

previous_qualification.gows_reproducibility: Two clean paths with independent empty caches and vendored dependencies, network disabled: byte-identical CGO binaries. Not a full image reproducibility claim.
previous_qualification.runtime_recipe_history: Root filesystem built with worker-restart false, then a config-only derivative restored WAHA_WORKER_RESTART_SESSIONS=true. All eight root filesystem layers were unchanged. The included Dockerfile combines the final semantics; that combined fresh build was not separately executed.
previous_qualification.runtime_smoke: Network disabled, empty temporary storage, real Nest/Core GOWS startup; API 401 without key, authorized sessions=[], actual stateless GetABContract with exact eight operations; zero lifecycle attempts; GOWS hash/help/ELF/native ABI checks passed.
previous_qualification.limits: External compiled inputs required. No runtime archive or dependency sources in this directory; no fresh-daemon/Podman/live-account or phone test. No active deployment pin changed.

qualification.gows_reproducibility: Two independent source paths and empty build caches, pinned compiler, vendored dependencies, networking disabled: byte-identical CGO binaries. Not a full image reproducibility claim.
qualification.limits: No server deployment or live account/client/phone test; no fresh-daemon or Podman import, no full image byte-reproducibility claim. PostgreSQL not qualified. Source provenance limits are recorded in the separate delivery.

runtime_smoke.audio: Compiled real WAV to Ogg/Opus, mono 48 kHz, decoded successfully

runtime_vertical.authorization_limit: Nest fixture overrides auth guard; API authentication and MCP authorization are checked separately.

source_inventory.npm_scope: Selected copyleft/native sources and installed notices; not every package source or native binary independently rebuilt.
